chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Wassa, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Hatim ibn Ismail, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) used to wear rings on their left hands.

key_terms.الْحَسَنُ وَالْحُسَيْنُ: Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them)

ai.seo_question: Did the Imams wear their rings on the left or right hand?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the wearing of signet rings on the left hand, a practice often associated with modesty and distinguishing the right hand for acts of purity. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on emulating the Prophet and Imams in daily etiquette (*adab*), reinforcing the continuity of prophetic traditions through the Imams. The narration underscores the significance of personal adornment as an expression of dignity and adherence to the Prophet's way.
